reserveReview.rationale: The September 15 mMEV transparency page explicitly identifies the same underlying strategy and wallets as mROX. Its current exposure matches the issuer API under token=mROX, while token=mMEV remains dated June 18. The fresh joint strategy reports gross assets, material borrow offsets and net equity; main positions exclude absolute deltas below $100,000 and are rounded to $1,000. The issuer-prepared September 8 report also covers mMEV and mROX jointly. Neither source establishes a complete standalone mMEV reserve allocation, and the whole joint pool must not be attributed to mMEV. Current linked final terms identify Midas Software GmbH as issuer; the strategy manager is not the token obligor.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Complete signed positions, residuals, custody relationships and allocation of the jointly reported mMEV/mROX pool remain unverified. Published protocol exposures and aggregate joint assets do not resolve standalone mMEV backing weights.
